# Tesseract OCR Service
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.tesseract-ocr.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.tesseract-ocr.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, document |
Tesseract OCR worker built atop a slim Python base with tesseract and poppler
installed. Used to extract text from images and PDFs in the ingestion pipeline.
